report.title: Chart None Fields Bug Fix Verification
report.description: This report tests the fix for chart rendering when labels_field and values_field are None. Previously, this would cause TypeError when extract_chart_data tried to use None as a field name.

dict_source.description: Test Case 1: Chart with dictionary source data and NO labels_field/values_field specified. The chart should automatically use dictionary keys as labels and values as data points.

list_with_fields.description: Test Case 2: Chart with list source data and EXPLICIT field mappings. This is the standard case that always worked.

multi_dict.description: Test Case 3: Multiple charts using different dictionary sources without field mappings. This tests that the fix works consistently across multiple charts on the same page.
